en.hubeali: Ali Bin IBrahimm, from his father, raising it,

‘Regarding the Words of the Mighty and Majestic [2:196] but he who cannot find (any offering) should Fast for three days during the Hajj and for seven days when he returns; these (make) ten (days) complete.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Its completion is the completion of the slaughtering’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from in a marfu‘ manner the following: “
This is about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘If he cannot find (offering) he must fast three days in al-Hajj and seven days when you return and this becomes ten complete.’ [2:196]
He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said that completing fasting is completing the offering obligation.’”
